offsetMultiplyAdd.description: Build-time scalar f32 policy for compute-only SPIR-V modules. Fuse (a + b*c) + d as a + fma(b,c,d) while preserving operand evaluation order. Other emitters and mixed-stage modules retain their existing policy.

multiDotLoops.description: Build-time policy for compute-only SPIR-V modules. Preserve innermost loops containing multiple emitted OpDot instructions with DontUnroll to avoid driver unrolling changing accumulated rounding. Other loops and other targets retain their existing controls.
